subject: A room that feels lived in
direction: Place the selected piece on the right; leave the left third quiet for the headline. Keep verticals straight and the room believable.
preparation: Natural light; actual furniture and personal objects.

subject: The room, in portrait
direction: Recompose from camera for a tall frame. Keep the entire hero piece readable; leave breathing room above and below.
preparation: Same room and piece as S01; do not rely on a tight crop.

subject: The same piece, considered
direction: Photograph the S01 piece at the same three-quarter angle and camera height. Show the full silhouette and every foot, with separation from the background.
preparation: Mark camera and piece positions; keep lens and light consistent.

subject: A detail with something to say
direction: Choose a joint, edge, seam or material meeting on the S01 piece. Make the construction legible; capture a wider companion for context.
preparation: Record the actual material, finish and maker, when confirmed.

subject: A real material conversation
direction: Photograph samples Leah is actually considering: one overhead still arrangement, one frame with a hand making a choice.
intended_use: Our Story; material study; founder letters
preparation: Real timber/textile/finish samples, working sketch and pencil.

subject: The transition plates
direction: Before moving the camera, capture the S01 setup with and without the piece. Include a neutral, uncluttered background frame for the study.
preparation: Tripod; fixed exposure and white balance; preserve natural shadow.

subject: The workshop in context
direction: Show where real work happens. Include the maker, bench and a readable piece or component. Let the maker continue their normal process.
preparation: Identify workshop, person, piece and process. This can be a separate story.

subject: Hands doing the work
direction: Capture one real operation: fitting a joint, shaping an edge or applying finish. Shoot a close view and a wider frame showing the action.
preparation: Choose the operation with the maker; preserve their normal safe setup.

subject: A finish or material decision
direction: Show the actual test, offcut or finish comparison beside the piece. Make the difference visible through light and angle.
preparation: Ask what is being compared and why; keep the explanation verbatim in notes.

subject: Leah, in the process
direction: Over the shoulder or hands selecting materials; include one wider frame of a real design conversation. Keep attention on her judgment.
preparation: A project or material decision Leah can discuss; portrait optional.

subject: Kody, building Patina
direction: Hands sketching a flow or an over-the-shoulder view of the actual prototype. Let a real working gesture carry the frame.
preparation: Use a cleared demo screen; exclude private client details and credentials.

subject: Kody and Leah, together
direction: Photograph an unforced conversation around materials or the prototype. Capture listening and exchange before asking for eye contact.
intended_use: Our Story; founder letters; selected press
preparation: A real table, their own notes and materials. Keep the room present.

subject: The maker at their bench
direction: Start with a working portrait and, if comfortable, one direct glance to camera. Give tools and work enough context to mean something.
preparation: Confirm the maker's name, role, workshop and preferred credit.

subject: Evidence of a life
direction: A used chair arm, book, mended textile or personal object in its actual setting. Choose something with a short, true story.
preparation: Use objects belonging to the people and room, with context recorded.

subject: A simple founder portrait
direction: One relaxed portrait together; individual frames only if time allows. Soft daylight, own clothes, no staged executive pose.
preparation: Optional. Founder portraits are not a first-release requirement.

subject: Room to place an invitation
direction: A quiet patch of room, wall, work surface or fabric with directional light. Leave a clean area for campaign copy.
preparation: Capture texture at a scale that stays calm behind readable type.

subject: Room light
direction: 8-10 seconds; locked frame; a small natural movement in the room.
preparation: S01 setup; horizontal and separate vertical take.

subject: A material choice
direction: 8-10 seconds; one hand places or turns a real sample, then leaves the frame.
preparation: S05 setup; hold still for 2 seconds at each end.

subject: A making gesture
direction: 8-10 seconds; one repeatable, safe action chosen by the maker.
preparation: S08 setup; record a clean beginning and end.

subject: A working exchange
direction: 8-10 seconds; Kody and Leah look at a material or prototype together.
preparation: S12 setup; natural gestures, no scripted speaking.
